title: 4 grammar mistakes in under a minute

say.text: Would you hit send? Be honest.
Your belongs to you. You're means you are. Say it in full, and it fits.
Mistake two. I could of gone.
Could have. We say could've, so our ears hear of. Our ears are lying.
Mistake three. Less students came today.
Can you count them? Then it's fewer. Less is for things you can't count.
Mistake four. Me and Tola went home.
Drop the other person. Me went home? No. So, Tola and I. Friend first.
Share this with a friend who still writes, your welcome.
